name: If-then-else branching
source: begin X := 10 ; if X > 5 then Y := 1 else Y := 0 ; if X < 5 then Z := 1 else Z := 0 end

name: While loop multiplication
source: begin X := 5 ; Y := 3 ; R := 0 ; while Y > 0 do begin R := R + X ; Y := Y - 1 end end

name: Nested while loops
source: begin I := 2 ; R := 0 ; while I > 0 do begin J := 3 ; while J > 0 do begin R := R + 1 ; J := J - 1 end ; I := I - 1 end end

name: Syntax error handling (missing end)
source: begin X := 10 ; while Y > 0 do begin R := 1 end

name: Runtime error handling (division by zero)
source: begin X := 10 ; Y := 0 ; Z := X / Y end
